aegisperms:command.aegis: Administers AegisPerms: the state, the explanations, the groups, the players, the files.
aegisperms:command.aegis.status: The state in force: the version, the generation, the mode, read-only, the file watch, the counts.
aegisperms:command.aegis.why: Explains, node by node, what the server would do if the player typed the line.
aegisperms:command.aegis.check: The decision of one key for a player, with the rule that answers.
aegisperms:command.aegis.search: The groups and players that hold a rule on a key or on a key that covers it.
aegisperms:command.aegis.catalog: The catalog keys that start with a given prefix.
aegisperms:command.aegis.manual: Writes this manual of the commands, in French or in English.
aegisperms:command.aegis.group: The groups: the list, the sheet, the creation, the rules, the inheritance.
aegisperms:command.aegis.player: The players: the sheet, the direct groups, the own rules, the note.
aegisperms:command.aegis.reload: Reloads both configuration files, validates them and applies them.
aegisperms:command.aegis.validate: Reloads and validates both files without applying anything.
aegisperms:command.aegis.backup: Copies both configuration files into a timestamped backup.
aegisperms:command.aegis.restore: Replaces both files with those of a backup, and applies them.
aegisperms:command.aegis.mode: Changes the mode in memory: enforce applies the decisions, observe computes them without applying.
minecraft:command.advancement: Grants or revokes advancements for players.
minecraft:command.advancement.grant: Grants advancements: all of them, a single one, or a branch from, until or through an advancement.
minecraft:command.advancement.revoke: Revokes advancements, with the same selections.
minecraft:command.attribute: Reads or changes an attribute of an entity: its base value, its modifiers.
minecraft:command.ban: Bans a player from the server, with a reason.
minecraft:command.ban-ip: Bans an IP address, or that of an online player.
minecraft:command.bossbar: Creates and configures custom boss bars.
minecraft:command.bossbar.get: Reads a value of a bar: its value, its maximum, its visibility, its players.
minecraft:command.bossbar.set: Configures a bar: the color, the name, the style, the value, the maximum, the visibility, the players.
minecraft:command.clone: Copies a region of blocks to another location.
minecraft:command.clone.from: The source region taken from another dimension.
minecraft:command.compute: Evaluates a number provider in a loot context, and returns it as the command result.
minecraft:command.compute.block: The context of a block: its position, its state, its block entity.
minecraft:command.compute.default: The default context: the execution position and the `this` entity.
minecraft:command.compute.entity: The context of an entity, exposed as `target_entity`.
minecraft:command.damage: Deals damage to an entity, of a given type and source.
minecraft:command.data: Gets, merges, modifies or removes the NBT data of a block, an entity or a storage.
minecraft:command.data.get: Reads the data, or the value at a path.
minecraft:command.data.modify: Modifies the value at a path: append, insert, merge, prepend, set.
minecraft:command.data.remove: Removes the value at a path.
minecraft:command.datapack: Enables, disables and lists data packs.
minecraft:command.datapack.create: Creates an empty data pack in the world folder.
minecraft:command.datapack.enable: Enables a data pack, at a given place in the order.
minecraft:command.datapack.list: The available and enabled data packs.
minecraft:command.debug: Profiles the server, and traces the execution of a function.
minecraft:command.debug.function: Runs a function while recording the detail of its commands into a file.
minecraft:command.debug.stop: Stops profiling and writes its report.
minecraft:command.debugconfig: Debug command, enabled by the `MC_DEBUG_DEV_COMMANDS` property: sends a player back to the configuration phase.
minecraft:command.debugconfig.config: Sends an online player back to the configuration phase.
minecraft:command.debugconfig.dialog: Shows a dialog to a player in the configuration phase.
minecraft:command.debugconfig.unconfig: Reconnects a player left in the configuration phase, by UUID.
minecraft:command.defaultgamemode: Sets the game mode of new players.
minecraft:command.deop: Revokes operator status from a player.
minecraft:command.dialog: Shows or clears dialogs on players' screens.
minecraft:command.dialog.clear: Closes the dialog shown to players.
minecraft:command.dialog.show: Shows a dialog, defined in a data pack or inline, to players.
minecraft:command.effect: Gives or clears status effects on entities.
minecraft:command.effect.clear: Clears one effect, or all of them.
minecraft:command.effect.give: Gives an effect, with its duration and amplifier.
minecraft:command.enchant: Enchants the item held by players.
minecraft:command.execute: Runs a command with a changed context: the executor, the position, the rotation, the dimension, under conditions, and storing its result.
minecraft:command.execute.align: Aligns the position to the block grid, on the given axes.
minecraft:command.execute.anchored: Sets the anchor point, eyes or feet.
minecraft:command.execute.as: Executes as other entities, without changing the position.
minecraft:command.execute.at: Executes at the position and rotation of other entities.
minecraft:command.execute.facing: Faces a position or an entity.
minecraft:command.execute.if: Continues only if a condition holds: a block, blocks, a biome, data, an entity, a function, an item, loaded chunks, a predicate, a score, a dimension.
minecraft:command.execute.on: Executes as a related entity: the attacker, the owner, the passenger, the target, the vehicle.
minecraft:command.execute.positioned: Executes at a given position, or at that of entities.
minecraft:command.execute.rotated: Executes with a given rotation, or that of entities.
minecraft:command.execute.store: Stores the command's result or success in a block, an entity, a storage, a score or a boss bar.
minecraft:command.execute.summon: Summons an entity and executes as it.
minecraft:command.execute.unless: Continues only if a condition does not hold.
minecraft:command.experience: Adds, sets or queries players' experience.
minecraft:command.fetchprofile: Fetches a player's profile, to copy its profile component or a head of them.
minecraft:command.fetchprofile.name: By a name.
minecraft:command.fill: Fills a region with a block.
minecraft:command.fillbiome: Changes the biome of a region.
minecraft:command.forceload.query: Says whether a chunk is forced, or lists the forced ones.
minecraft:command.forceload.remove: Removes chunks, or all of them.
minecraft:command.function: Runs a data pack function, or a tag of functions, with its macro arguments.
minecraft:command.gamerule: Reads or sets a game rule.
minecraft:command.help: The command help: the list of the commands one can use, or the syntax of one of them.
minecraft:command.item: Replaces or modifies the item of a slot, of a block or of an entity.
minecraft:command.item.fill: Fills several slots with an item, or with those of other slots, repeated when they are fewer.
minecraft:command.item.modify: Applies an item modifier to a slot.
minecraft:command.item.override: Replaces several slots with an item or with those of other slots, and clears the remaining ones.
minecraft:command.item.replace: Replaces the item of a slot with a given item, or with that of another slot.
minecraft:command.jfr: Starts and stops a Java Flight Recorder recording of the server.
minecraft:command.jfr.stop: Stops the recording and writes its file.
minecraft:command.kick: Kicks players off the server, with a reason.
minecraft:command.locate: Locates the nearest structure, biome or point of interest.
minecraft:command.loot: Distributes the loot of a table, a mined block, a killed entity or a fishing.
minecraft:command.loot.insert: Into a container at a position.
minecraft:command.loot.replace: Into a slot of a block or an entity.
minecraft:command.loot.spawn: On the ground, at a position.
minecraft:command.me: Writes a third-person action in chat: "* Name does something".
minecraft:command.msg: Sends a private message to one or more players.
minecraft:command.op: Makes a player a server operator.
minecraft:command.perf: Starts and stops a ten-second performance profiling.
minecraft:command.perf.stop: Stops profiling and writes its report.
minecraft:command.place: Places a piece of world generation: a feature, a structure, a template, a jigsaw.
minecraft:command.place.jigsaw: A jigsaw, from a template pool.
minecraft:command.place.template: A structure template, with its rotation and mirror.
minecraft:command.posteffect: Applies or removes screen post-processing effects on players.
minecraft:command.random: Rolls a random number, or manages random sequences.
minecraft:command.random.reset: Resets a sequence, or all of them.
minecraft:command.random.roll: Rolls a number in a range and announces it to everyone.
minecraft:command.random.value: Rolls a number in a range, for the executor alone.
minecraft:command.recipe: Gives recipes to players or takes them away.
minecraft:command.recipe.give: Gives one recipe, or all of them.
minecraft:command.recipe.take: Takes one recipe, or all of them.
minecraft:command.return: Ends a function returning a value, failing, or with the result of a command.
minecraft:command.return.run: Ends with the result of the command that follows.
minecraft:command.ride: Makes an entity ride another, or dismount.
minecraft:command.rotate: Rotates an entity: to a rotation, a position or an entity.
minecraft:command.save-all.flush: Writing everything to disk before returning.
minecraft:command.say: Sends a message to all players, in the executor's name.
minecraft:command.schedule: Schedules a function to run after a delay in ticks.
minecraft:command.schedule.clear: Cancels the scheduled runs of a function.
minecraft:command.schedule.function: Schedules a function, replacing or appending to its planned runs.
minecraft:command.scoreboard: Manages the scoreboard's objectives and scores.
minecraft:command.scoreboard.objectives: The objectives: create, list, modify, display, remove them.
minecraft:command.scoreboard.players: The scores: get, set, add, remove, operate, reset, enable them.
minecraft:command.setblock: Places a block at a position.
minecraft:command.setidletimeout: Sets the idle time before a player is kicked.
minecraft:command.spectate: Makes a spectator-mode player spectate an entity.
minecraft:command.spreadplayers: Spreads entities over an area, away from each other.
minecraft:command.stopwatch: Manages real-time stopwatches, untouched by ticks or pause.
minecraft:command.stopwatch.create: Creates a stopwatch and starts it.
minecraft:command.stopwatch.query: Reads the elapsed time, in seconds or multiplied by a scale.
minecraft:command.swing: Animates entities' arm swing: the hand, the animation, the duration.
minecraft:command.tag: Adds, removes or lists entity tags.
minecraft:command.team: Manages the scoreboard teams and their options.
minecraft:command.team.empty: Removes all members of a team.
minecraft:command.team.list: The teams, or the members of one team.
minecraft:command.team.modify: Sets a team option: the color, the name, friendly fire, visibility, collision, the prefixes.
minecraft:command.teammsg: Sends a message to one's teammates.
minecraft:command.teleport: Teleports entities to a position or to another entity.
minecraft:command.tellraw: Sends a raw JSON message to players.
minecraft:command.test: Runs and manages game tests: their structures, their runs, their cleanup.
minecraft:command.test.clearall: Clears all test structures within a radius.
minecraft:command.test.clearthat: Clears the test structure aimed at.
minecraft:command.test.locate: Locates the instances of a test in the loaded chunks.
minecraft:command.test.pos: Gives the relative position of the aimed block in a test.
minecraft:command.test.run: Runs tests, with their repeats, rotation and grid.
minecraft:command.test.runmultiple: Runs tests repeating each one within the same batch.
minecraft:command.tick: Queries or sets the tick rate, freezes it, steps or sprints it.
minecraft:command.tick.query: Queries the rate and the state.
minecraft:command.tick.rate: Sets the rate, in ticks per second.
minecraft:command.tick.sprint: Runs ticks as fast as possible.
minecraft:command.tick.step: Steps a number of ticks, the game frozen.
minecraft:command.time: Reads or sets the time of day of a world clock.
minecraft:command.time.of: Targets a given clock, instead of the dimension's.
minecraft:command.time.query: Queries the time: the day, the time of day, the total time.
minecraft:command.time.rate: Sets the speed of a clock.
minecraft:command.time.set: Sets the time, in ticks or by a marker: day, night, noon, midnight.
minecraft:command.title: Shows a title, a subtitle or a message above players' action bar, and sets their timings.
minecraft:command.trigger: Modifies a `trigger` objective for oneself, which any player can do.
minecraft:command.version: Shows the server version, its protocol and its pack formats.
minecraft:command.waypoint: Manages the waypoints of the locator bar.
minecraft:command.waypoint.modify: Changes the color or the style of an entity's waypoint.
minecraft:command.weather: Sets the weather, for a duration.
minecraft:command.whitelist: Manages the whitelist of the allowed players.
minecraft:command.worldborder: Configures the world border: its size, its center, its damage, its warnings.
minecraft:command.worldborder.add: Grows or shrinks the border, over a given time.
minecraft:command.worldborder.damage: Sets the damage and its buffer.
minecraft:command.worldborder.set: Sets the size, over a given time.
minecraft:command.worldborder.warning: Sets the warning distance and time.
